snapshot_normalization: Each SQL file is the SQL from its spec file at the listed commit, with one final newline. archive.sql follows 8c4e221 for recovery; note_target.seen_hash keeps its older comment so stored schema text is unchanged. index.sql takes session.native_id_encoding from 5551b6e3 and everything else from aca97f21. Comments outside CREATE statements were later rewritten in this repository; stored schema text is unaffected. sql_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the file in this repository.

runtime_metadata_overlay.changes: Adds meta keys acquisition_lineage (written at fresh creation) and copy_preparation (a versioned JSON value); copy preparation completion is recorded in client_request. No table changes. Upgrading an older format never invents a missing lineage.

observed_context_overlay.changes: Adds observed_context: the declared context of each observed Claude input. Imported inputs and their CHECK are unchanged. The upgrade fills it from each input's first observation. A format-4 archive missing a context refuses; a pending format-3 copy preparation must be finished with a format-3 build before upgrading. An expression index finds a main file's tool-result inputs without scanning other inputs.
